OpenEXRCore 3.3.5
https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/openexr/releases/tag/v3.3.5

OpenEXRCore sources and configuration templates are taken from this release.
The C decoder uses the Imath 3.1.12 half headers and libdeflate 1.18 sources
pinned by upstream. License texts are in LICENSE.md, Imath/LICENSE.md, and
libdeflate/COPYING.
